بيلون

بَيْلُونٌ [_Fullers' earth, which is used for scouring cloths, and is sometimes used in the bath, instead of soap;_] the _yellow_ [or rather _yellowish,_ or _yellowish gray,_ and sometimes _white,_ or _whitish,_] _earth known by the name of_ طَفْل. (TA, from Esh-Shiháb El-'Ajamee.)
